items.title: Govt relaxes experience rules for state commercial bank CEOs
items.description: The change comes as the government has cancelled the remaining tenure of the contractual MDs and CEOs of three banks: Sonali, Janata and Rupali.

items.title: The 2026 Economics Nobel Prize: The Policy Lesson from Hall-Woodford Models
items.description: The 2026 Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences went to Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford for their work on economic models that help governments and central banks respond to economic volatility.
